name: Simply Asking
description:
Simply Asking is a brain for your business: your documents, records, and operating knowledge, all of it finally connected. Your company brain teaches AI the vocabulary of your business, how you talk about work, and gives everyone one source of truth they can trust.

Connect it to Claude and ask the way you'd ask a colleague. Every answer is built from your own material, never from general internet knowledge, and every answer shows its work: numbered citations and the source documents so you can verify before you act. 

Claude sees exactly what your own Simply Asking account can see, nothing more. Read-only by design. Claude can ask your business anything, and it can't change a thing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Simply Asking to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Simply Asking to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://auth.simplyasking.io/functions/v1/mcp-server. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Simply Asking MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply Asking lists 17 MCP tools, including ask_simply_asking, count_by_doc_type, get_agent_status, get_contradiction_health, get_fact_trust, get_facts_used_rate, get_gap_close_rate, get_insights_summary, get_security_posture, list_active_agents, list_recent_documents, and list_team_members.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Simply Asking?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Simply Asking in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Simply Asking MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply Asking requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Simply Asking is developed by Simply Asking. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
